Based on the eye-tracking data and zoomed crops, the participant's gaze behavior has been analyzed and summarized into chronological phases.

### Gaze Analysis over Time

* **Phase 1 (t=1.0 s to t=5.0 s):** The participant focused on the right side of the front row, specifically looking at the student in the pink shirt (**t=1.0 s**), the student in the blue hoodie (**t=2.4 s** to **t=3.6 s**), and the desk/pencil case area of the student in the plaid shirt (**t=5.0 s**).
* **Phase 2 (t=7.2 s to t=19.4 s):** Gaze shifted to the left and center-left of the classroom. The participant scanned the middle-row student in the white top (**t=7.2 s**), the front-left student in the black shirt (**t=8.7 s**), the middle-row student in the black jacket (**t=12.5 s** to **t=13.8 s**), and the student in the grey sweatshirt (**t=15.3 s** to **t=19.4 s**).
* **Phase 3 (t=25.1 s to t=28.0 s):** Gaze returned to the right side of the room, focusing on the student in the plaid shirt (**t=25.1 s**), the student pointing in the background (**t=26.1 s** to **t=27.2 s**), and the student in the blue hoodie (**t=28.0 s**).
* **Phase 4 (t=29.6 s to t=33.3 s):** The participant scanned the background posters and the upper-left wall area (**t=29.6 s** to **t=33.3 s**).
* **Phase 5 (t=34.8 s to t=37.1 s):** Gaze briefly returned to the front-left student in the black shirt (**t=34.8 s**) and the student in the plaid shirt on the far right (**t=37.1 s**).
* **Phase 6 (t=44.1 s to t=50.4 s):** The participant focused on the upper-center wall and background posters (**t=44.1 s** to **t=47.4 s**), before shifting to the right-side wall column (**t=48.6 s** to **t=50.4 s**).
* **Phase 7 (t=51.5 s to t=61.7 s):** Gaze returned to the students, scanning the front-right student in the plaid shirt (**t=51.5 s** to **t=52.1 s**), the background students on the left (**t=56.9 s**), the desk area of the front-left student (**t=59.7 s**), and the background posters again (**t=61.7 s**).
* **Phase 8 (t=62.6 s to t=112.4 s):** In the final phase, the participant's gaze alternated between the background posters/wall (**t=62.6 s**, **t=67.2 s** to **t=70.7 s**, **t=79.2 s** to **t=88.4 s**, **t=91.6 s** to **t=101.4 s**, **t=108.9 s** to **t=112.4 s**), the right-side wall column (**t=66.3 s**, **t=76.1 s**), and the front-right student in the plaid shirt (**t=107.3 s**).

### Gaze Behavior Evaluation

The participant demonstrated a highly active scanning pattern, alternating attention between individual students in the front and middle rows, background educational posters, and structural elements of the room like the right-side column. Since no specific evaluation criteria were provided, this gaze behavior is characterized as a neutral, exploratory visual search of the classroom environment.
